Bundled third-party mods (installed into the game folder by "Install everything"):

- Cyber Engine Tweaks 1.37.1 ("Scripting fixes") — MIT License, https://github.com/maximegmd/CyberEngineTweaks
  License: game/bin/x64/LICENSE
- redscript 0.5.31 — MIT License, https://github.com/jac3km4/redscript

When the game updates and these stop working, download newer versions and replace
the files under thirdparty/game (same folder layout as the game folder).
